content.text:
<action>
SEARCH_RESULT=$(curl -s -X POST https://slack.com/api/search.messages \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>" \
  -d "query=launch-checklist")

CHANNEL=$(echo $SEARCH_RESULT | jq -r '.messages[0].channel')
TS=$(echo $SEARCH_RESULT | jq -r '.messages[0].ts')

REACTIONS=$(curl -s -X POST https://slack.com/api/reactions.get \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>" \
  -d "channel=$CHANNEL&timestamp=$TS&full=true")

ROCKET_USERS=$(echo $REACTIONS | jq -r '.message.reactions[] | select(.name=="rocket") | .users[]')

echo "Users who reacted with 🚀:"
echo "$ROCKET_USERS"

# Now get user info for each user
USERS_LIST=$(curl -s -X POST https://slack.com/api/users.list \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>" \
  -d "limit=1000")

# For each user in ROCKET_USERS, get their admin/owner status
for user_id in $ROCKET_USERS; do
  USER_INFO=$(echo $USERS_LIST | jq ".members[] | select(.id==\"$user_id\")")
  USER_NAME=$(echo $USER_INFO | jq -r '.real_name // .name')
  IS_ADMIN=$(echo $USER_INFO | jq -r '.is_admin')
  IS_OWNER=$(echo $USER_INFO | jq -r '.is_owner')
  echo "User: $USER_NAME ($user_id) - Admin: $IS_ADMIN, Owner: $IS_OWNER"
done
</action>
</function_calls>
